verses.text: Inasmuch as many have undertaken to compile an account of the things accomplished among us,
verses.textZh: 提阿非羅大人哪，有好些人提筆作書，述說在我們中間所成就的事，是照傳道的人從起初親眼看見又傳給我們的。

verses.text: just as they were handed down to us by those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word,
verses.textZh: a

verses.text: it seemed fitting for me as well, having investigated everything carefully from the beginning, to write [it] out for you in consecutive order, most excellent Theophilus;
verses.textZh: 這些事我既從起頭都詳細考察了，就定意要按著次序寫給你，

verses.text: so that you may know the exact truth about the things you have been taught.
verses.textZh: 使你知道所學之道都是確實的。

verses.text: In the days of Herod, king of Judea, there was a priest named Zacharias, of the division of Abijah; and he had a wife from the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.
verses.textZh: 當猶太王希律的時候，亞比雅班裡有一個祭司，名叫撒迦利亞；他妻子是亞倫的後人，名叫以利沙伯。

verses.text: They were both righteous in the sight of God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and requirements of the Lord.
verses.textZh: 他們二人在神面前都是義人，遵行主的一切誡命禮儀，沒有可指摘的，

verses.text: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they were both advanced in years.
verses.textZh: 只是沒有孩子；因為以利沙伯不生育，兩個人又年紀老邁了。

verses.text: Now it happened [that] while he was performing his priestly service before God in the [appointed] order of his division,
verses.textZh: 撒迦利亞按班次在神面前供祭司的職分，

verses.text: according to the custom of the priestly office, he was chosen by lot to enter the temple of the Lord and burn incense.
verses.textZh: 照祭司的規矩掣籤，得進主殿燒香。

verses.text: And the whole multitude of the people were in prayer outside at the hour of the incense offering.
verses.textZh: 燒香的時候，眾百姓在外面禱告。

verses.text: And an angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing to the right of the altar of incense.
verses.textZh: 有主的使者站在香壇的右邊，向他顯現。

verses.text: Zacharias was troubled when he saw [the angel], and fear gripped him.
verses.textZh: 撒迦利亞看見，就驚慌害怕。

verses.text: But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zacharias, for your petition has been heard, and your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you will give him the name John.
verses.textZh: 天使對他說：撒迦利亞，不要害怕，因為你的祈禱已經被聽見了。你的妻子以利沙伯要給你生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫約翰。

verses.text: 'You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.
verses.textZh: 你必歡喜快樂；有許多人因他出世，也必喜樂。

verses.text: 'For he will be great in the sight of the Lord; and he will drink no wine or liquor, and he will be filled with the Holy Spirit while yet in his mother's womb.
verses.textZh: 他在主面前將要為大，淡酒濃酒都不喝，從母腹裡就被聖靈充滿了。

verses.text: 'And he will turn many of the sons of Israel back to the Lord their God.
verses.textZh: 他要使許多以色列人回轉，歸於主─他們的神。

verses.text: 'It is he who will go [as a forerunner] before Him in the spirit and power of Elijah, TO TURN THE HEARTS OF THE FATHERS BACK TO THE CHILDREN, and the disobedient to the attitude of the righteous, so as to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.'
verses.textZh: 他必有以利亞的心志能力，行在主的前面，叫為父的心轉向兒女，叫悖逆的人轉從義人的智慧，又為主預備合用的百姓。

verses.text: Zacharias said to the angel, 'How will I know this [for certain]? For I am an old man and my wife is advanced in years.'
verses.textZh: 撒迦利亞對天使說：我憑著甚麼可知道這事呢？我已經老了，我的妻子也年紀老邁了。

verses.text: The angel answered and said to him, 'I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God, and I have been sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.
verses.textZh: 天使回答說：我是站在神面前的加百列，奉差而來對你說話，將這好信息報給你。

verses.text: 'And behold, you shall be silent and unable to speak until the day when these things take place, because you did not believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.'
verses.textZh: 到了時候，這話必然應驗；只因你不信，你必啞吧，不能說話，直到這事成就的日子。

verses.text: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and were wondering at his delay in the temple.
verses.textZh: 百姓等候撒迦利亞，詫異他許久在殿裡。

verses.text: But when he came out, he was unable to speak to them; and they realized that he had seen a vision in the temple; and he kept making signs to them, and remained mute.
verses.textZh: 及至他出來，不能和他們說話，他們就知道他在殿裡見了異象；因為他直向他們打手式，竟成了啞吧。

verses.text: When the days of his priestly service were ended, he went back home.
verses.textZh: 他供職的日子已滿，就回家去了。

verses.text: After these days Elizabeth his wife became pregnant, and she kept herself in seclusion for five months, saying,
verses.textZh: 這些日子以後，他的妻子以利沙伯懷了孕，就隱藏了五個月，

verses.text: 'This is the way the Lord has dealt with me in the days when He looked [with favor] upon [me], to take away my disgrace among men.'
verses.textZh: 說：主在眷顧我的日子，這樣看待我，要把我在人間的羞恥除掉。

verses.text: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city in Galilee called Nazareth,
verses.textZh: 到了第六個月，天使加百列奉神的差遣往加利利的一座城去，這城名叫拿撒勒，

verses.text: to a virgin engaged to a man whose name was Joseph, of the descendants of David; and the virgin's name was Mary.
verses.textZh: 到一個童女那裡，是已經許配大衛家的一個人，名叫約瑟。童女的名字叫馬利亞；

verses.text: And coming in, he said to her, 'Greetings, favored one! The Lord [is] with you.'
verses.textZh: 天使進去，對他說：蒙大恩的女子，我問你安，主和你同在了！

verses.text: But she was very perplexed at [this] statement, and kept pondering what kind of salutation this was.
verses.textZh: 馬利亞因這話就很驚慌，又反復思想這樣問安是甚麼意思。

verses.text: The angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; for you have found favor with God.
verses.textZh: 天使對他說：馬利亞，不要怕！你在神面前已經蒙恩了。

verses.text: 'And behold, you will conceive in your womb and bear a son, and you shall name Him Jesus.
verses.textZh: 你要懷孕生子，可以給他起名叫耶穌。

verses.text: 'He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High; and the Lord God will give Him the throne of His father David;
verses.textZh: 他要為大，稱為至高者的兒子；主神要把他祖大衛的位給他。

verses.text: and He will reign over the house of Jacob forever, and His kingdom will have no end.'
verses.textZh: 他要作雅各家的王，直到永遠；他的國也沒有窮盡。

verses.text: Mary said to the angel, 'How can this be, since I am a virgin?'
verses.textZh: 馬利亞對天使說：我沒有出嫁，怎麼有這事呢？

verses.text: The angel answered and said to her, 'The Holy Spirit will come upon you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you; and for that reason the holy Child shall be called the Son of God.
verses.textZh: 天使回答說：聖靈要臨到你身上，至高者的能力要蔭庇你，因此所要生的聖者必稱為神的兒子（或作：所要生的，必稱為聖，稱為神的兒子）。

verses.text: 'And behold, even your relative Elizabeth has also conceived a son in her old age; and she who was called barren is now in her sixth month.
verses.textZh: 況且你的親戚以利沙伯，在年老的時候也懷了男胎，就是那素來稱為不生育的，現在有孕六個月了。

verses.text: 'For nothing will be impossible with God.'
verses.textZh: 因為，出於神的話，沒有一句不帶能力的。

verses.text: And Mary said, 'Behold, the bondslave of the Lord; may it be done to me according to your word.' And the angel departed from her.
verses.textZh: 馬利亞說：我是主的使女，情願照你的話成就在我身上。天使就離開他去了。

verses.text: Now at this time Mary arose and went in a hurry to the hill country, to a city of Judah,
verses.textZh: 那時候，馬利亞起身，急忙往山地裡去，來到猶大的一座城；

verses.text: and entered the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.
verses.textZh: 進了撒迦利亞的家，問以利沙伯安。

verses.text: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.
verses.textZh: 以利沙伯一聽馬利亞問安，所懷的胎就在腹裡跳動。以利沙伯且被聖靈充滿，

verses.text: And she cried out with a loud voice and said, 'Blessed [are] you among women, and blessed [is] the fruit of your womb!
verses.textZh: 高聲喊著說：你在婦女中是有福的！你所懷的胎也是有福的！

verses.text: 'And how has it [happened] to me, that the mother of my Lord would come to me?
verses.textZh: 我主的母到我這裡來，這是從那裡得的呢？

verses.text: 'For behold, when the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy.
verses.textZh: 因為你問安的聲音一入我耳，我腹裡的胎就歡喜跳動。

verses.text: 'And blessed [is] she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what had been spoken to her by the Lord.'
verses.textZh: 這相信的女子是有福的！因為主對他所說的話都要應驗。

verses.text: And Mary said: 'My soul exalts the Lord,
verses.textZh: 馬利亞說：我心尊主為大；

verses.text: And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.
verses.textZh: 我靈以神我的救主為樂；

verses.text: 'For He has had regard for the humble state of His bondslave; For behold, from this time on all generations will count me blessed.
verses.textZh: 因為他顧念他使女的卑微；從今以後，萬代要稱我有福。

verses.text: 'For the Mighty One has done great things for me; And holy is His name.
verses.textZh: 那有權能的，為我成就了大事；他的名為聖。

verses.text: 'AND HIS MERCY IS UPON GENERATION AFTER GENERATION TOWARD THOSE WHO FEAR HIM.
verses.textZh: 他憐憫敬畏他的人，直到世世代代。

verses.text: 'He has done mighty deeds with His arm; He has scattered [those who were] proud in the thoughts of their heart.
verses.textZh: 他用膀臂施展大能；那狂傲的人正心裡妄想就被他趕散了。

verses.text: 'He has brought down rulers from [their] thrones, And has exalted those who were humble.
verses.textZh: 他叫有權柄的失位，叫卑賤的升高；

verses.text: 'HE HAS FILLED THE HUNGRY WITH GOOD THINGS; And sent away the rich empty-handed.
verses.textZh: 叫飢餓的得飽美食，叫富足的空手回去。

verses.text: 'He has given help to Israel His servant, In remembrance of His mercy,
verses.textZh: 他扶助了他的僕人以色列，

verses.text: As He spoke to our fathers, To Abraham and his descendants forever.'
verses.textZh: 為要記念亞伯拉罕和他的後裔，施憐憫直到永遠，正如從前對我們列祖所說的話。

verses.text: And Mary stayed with her about three months, and [then] returned to her home.
verses.textZh: 馬利亞和以利沙伯同住，約有三個月，就回家去了。

verses.text: Now the time had come for Elizabeth to give birth, and she gave birth to a son.
verses.textZh: 以利沙伯的產期到了，就生了一個兒子。

verses.text: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had displayed His great mercy toward her; and they were rejoicing with her.
verses.textZh: 鄰里親族聽見主向他大施憐憫，就和他一同歡樂。

verses.text: And it happened that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child, and they were going to call him Zacharias, after his father.
verses.textZh: 到了第八日，他們來要給孩子行割禮，並要照他父親的名字叫他撒迦利亞。

verses.text: But his mother answered and said, 'No indeed; but he shall be called John.'
verses.textZh: 他母親說：不可！要叫他約翰。

verses.text: And they said to her, 'There is no one among your relatives who is called by that name.'
verses.textZh: 他們說：你親族中沒有叫這名字的。

verses.text: And they made signs to his father, as to what he wanted him called.
verses.textZh: 他們就向他父親打手式，問他要叫這孩子甚麼名字。

verses.text: And he asked for a tablet and wrote as follows, 'His name is John.' And they were all astonished.
verses.textZh: 他要了一塊寫字的板，就寫上，說：他的名字是約翰。他們便都希奇。

verses.text: And at once his mouth was opened and his tongue [loosed], and he [began] to speak in praise of God.
verses.textZh: 撒迦利亞的口立時開了，舌頭也舒展了，就說出話來，稱頌神。

verses.text: Fear came on all those living around them; and all these matters were being talked about in all the hill country of Judea.
verses.textZh: 周圍居住的人都懼怕；這一切的事就傳遍了猶太的山地。

verses.text: All who heard them kept them in mind, saying, 'What then will this child [turn out to] be?' For the hand of the Lord was certainly with him.
verses.textZh: 凡聽見的人都將這事放在心裡，說：這個孩子將來怎麼樣呢？因為有主與他同在。

verses.text: And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying:
verses.textZh: 他父親撒迦利亞被聖靈充滿了，就預言說：

verses.text: 'Blessed [be] the Lord God of Israel, For He has visited us and accomplished redemption for His people,
verses.textZh: 主─以色列的神是應當稱頌的！因他眷顧他的百姓，為他們施行救贖，

verses.text: And has raised up a horn of salvation for us In the house of David His servant--
verses.textZh: 在他僕人大衛家中，為我們興起了拯救的角，

verses.text: As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets from of old--
verses.textZh: 正如主藉著從創世以來聖先知的口所說的話，

verses.text: Salvation FROM OUR ENEMIES, And FROM THE HAND OF ALL WHO HATE US;
verses.textZh: 拯救我們脫離仇敵和一切恨我們之人的手，

verses.text: To show mercy toward our fathers, And to remember His holy covenant,
verses.textZh: 向我們列祖施憐憫，記念他的聖約─

verses.text: The oath which He swore to Abraham our father,
verses.textZh: 就是他對我們祖宗亞伯拉罕所起的誓─

verses.text: To grant us that we, being rescued from the hand of our enemies, Might serve Him without fear,
verses.textZh: 叫我們既從仇敵手中被救出來，

verses.text: In holiness and righteousness before Him all our days.
verses.textZh: 就可以終身在他面前，坦然無懼的用聖潔、公義事奉他。

verses.text: 'And you, child, will be called the prophet of the Most High; For you will go on BEFORE THE LORD TO PREPARE HIS WAYS;
verses.textZh: 孩子阿！你要稱為至高者的先知；因為你要行在主的前面，預備他的道路，

verses.text: To give to His people [the] knowledge of salvation By the forgiveness of their sins,
verses.textZh: 叫他的百姓因罪得赦，就知道救恩。

verses.text: Because of the tender mercy of our God, With which the Sunrise from on high will visit us,
verses.textZh: 因我們神憐憫的心腸，叫清晨的日光從高天臨到我們，

verses.text: TO SHINE UPON THOSE WHO SIT IN DARKNESS AND THE SHADOW OF DEATH, To guide our feet into the way of peace.'
verses.textZh: 要照亮坐在黑暗中死蔭裡的人，把我們的腳引到平安的路上。

verses.text: And the child continued to grow and to become strong in spirit, and he lived in the deserts until the day of his public appearance to Israel.
verses.textZh: 那孩子漸漸長大，心靈強健，住在曠野，直到他顯明在以色列人面前的日子。
